questionResults.question: How many pantries are in each city?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT a.city, COUNT(p.pantry_id) AS number_of_pantries
FROM pantry p
JOIN adress a ON a.address_id = p.address_id
GROUP BY a.city;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Denver has 1 pantry, Phoenix has 1 pantry, and Provo has 1 pantry.

questionResults.question: What is the total quantity of food in each pantry, including shelves and cupboards?
questionResults.sql:
WITH pantry_shelf_totals AS (
    SELECT pantry_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_shelf_quantity
    FROM shelfs
    GROUP BY pantry_id
),
pantry_cupboard_totals AS (
    SELECT pantry_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_cupboard_quantity
    FROM cupboards
    GROUP BY pantry_id
)
SELECT p.pantry_id, 
       COALESCE(pst.total_shelf_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(pct.total_cupboard_quantity, 0) AS total_quantity
FROM pantry p
LEFT JOIN pantry_shelf_totals pst ON p.pantry_id = pst.pantry_id
LEFT JOIN pantry_cupboard_totals pct ON p.pantry_id = pct.pantry_id
ORDER BY p.pantry_id;

questionResults.question: Which pantry has the most food?
questionResults.sql:
WITH total_quantities AS (
    SELECT pantry_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM (
        SELECT pantry_id, quantity FROM shelfs
        UNION ALL
        SELECT pantry_id, quantity FROM cupboards
    )
    GROUP BY pantry_id
)
SELECT pantry_id
FROM total_quantities
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The pantry with the most food has the pantry ID: 1.
